name: Marshal Heavy Service Revolver (MR-6)
notes: Dual power cells, alternating discharge with audible metallic clank on cell switch-over; deliberate cadence; close-range concussive knockdown, surprising medium-range accuracy; defeats light armor, stresses heavier plating. Worn opposite the spade. Slang is unofficial by design ("no sentimental nickname baked into doctrine").

character_and_slang.character: A duty hand cannon that happens to fire energy instead of lead — the sidearm reads as heavy and conventional despite its energy mechanism.
character_and_slang.informal_names: Casually referred to as a 'hand cannon' or a 'blunderbuss'.
character_and_slang.standing: These are in-world slang, not alternate designations — the same distinction already recorded for 'spade' on the Spatha Moderna. Recorded as informal usage rather than promoted to aliases.
